messages:
anya: thinking out loud — we need a concrete plan for per-customer precision profiles + runtime fallback semantics. sketching tradeoffs and where the profile lives.
mike_k: agreed. main questions: store profiles with model artifact (git/registry) vs central config service? cache invalidation cost matters.
priya: +1. model artifact gives reproducibility but harder to patch rapidly. central config enables live changes but needs strong audit + rollout controls.
sam: runtime ops note: if we go central, we must version and pin at request time for reproducible billing/qa. also need a graceful fallback when config fetch fails.
anya: proposal: keep default profile in model artifact; allow optional customer override stored in "precision-config-service" with tiers: emergency, canary, gradual. runtime merges: override -> model default -> global default.
zach: how does merging look? priority/resolution rules need to be explicit, and what fields in a profile? e.g. target_bitwidths, quality_budget, fallback_policy.
priya: suggested schema (simple):

```json
{
  "profile_version": "2026-03-21.v1",
  "targets": {
    "compute": "int8|fp8|4bit",
    "max_quality_delta": 0.02,
    "measurement": "deg_score_v2"
  },
  "fallback_policy": {
    "on_quality_regress": "fallback_to:int8_model_v1",
    "on_latency_spike": "bypass_batching"
  },
  "rollout": {"mode":"canary","pct":5}
}
```

mike_k: looks good. we should include fields for "calibration_holdouts" and "eval_promptset_id" so QA can reproduce and for automatic regression checks.
anya: operational concerns — how do we detect quality regressions? runtime can emit per-candidate small-sample metrics (deg_score, token_confidence) but need offline eval to confirm.
sam: runtime-bot note: added telemetry stub for deg_score and top_k_disagree to the spec earlier this week.
runtime-bot: telemetry spec published: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/degscore-v2 (stub)
priya: ok, so flow: when a new customer override is pushed -> pre-check: offline sim on representative traces (if available) -> quick canary (5% traffic) with realtime deg_score monitor -> if pass, ramp. revert on sustained deg_score delta > threshold for 10m.
zach: rollback automation is critical. also need a CLI for ops to force-evict profile caches on nodes.
anya: agree. action items: 1) add schema fields for calibration_holdouts + eval_promptset_id (priya), 2) design config-service API including versioned GET with ETag and a POST for overrides (mike_k), 3) runtime changes: merge logic + cache eviction endpoint + telemetry hooks (sam), 4) docs + rollout runbook (anya).
priya: quick note on metrics: deg_score alone can be noisy. combine with top_k_disagree and perplexity_delta. use weighted signal for automated gating.
mike_k: security: overrides must be scoped to org id and signed; audit log required. also rate-limit override API to prevent accidental mass changes.
sam: implementation constraint: devices with small memory (edge dedicated) may need to inline only a compact profile; add an encoded "lite" profile path in the schema.
anya: timeline? I'd like an RFC follow-up doc by EOW and a small canary next week for an internal non-customer endpoint.
zach: volunteering to draft the runtime checklist for eviction/rollback.
priya: will mock the offline sim harness for a few customers' traces.
mike_k: I'll draft the config-service API proto and auth model.
anya: thanks all — we'll sync in the eng-ml weekly to review PRs. :thumbsup:
